display_name: WiSig R17 三方向实频谱幅度融合
description: 冻结 WiSig R17 和实增益先验，在低城区 Full 源 U 配对上训练三个频率实增益方向，RX6 新物理包筛查。
authorization: 当前聊天 01a2204f-647a-7903-ba29-81cfe8f8749b 的融合研发目标及 N607 有显存即启动要求。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32 TF32off; independent CPU scorer

data.representation: 256 complex points, 8 x 32 groups; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL default head for evaluation only
data.physical_ids_ref: Source V RX6: seed 2026112905+day choose 100 per day 1/2/3, excluding initial 1800 panel IDs, three subsequent 300 panels and one smoke ID.
data.label_map_ref: Original six classes; no L/U TX label used in training, source V label only after independent freeze
data.train_ratio: 7/63/30; use 52604 U after existing calibration exclusion
data.validation_ref: Reuse existing registered source cache and validated source roles
data.leo_config_ref: Original source full/post_sync/noEQ, 25MHz, 2462MHz, reference SNR 30 dB, reflect boundary, restoration/validation/draw0; clean and practical_low_urban.

permissions.claim_scope: Only source U_s IQ and simulated paired disturbances. Frozen R17/realgain IQ models; no F weights or outputs in fit, no TX labels or V/target. Source V labels only in independent scorer after all two-view predictions fixed.

checkpoint.initialization: New three-direction real-gain head zero initialized; full R17 and separately trained WiSig realgain prior frozen, source-only. Prior urban and dose candidate outputs used only as control and exclusion evidence.

sources.role: WiSig source-only realgain and prior physical-gain candidate as frozen controls; source V RX1 already exposed
Full unroll_unshared R17 E20/4940; source-only TX-free F-free training
WiSig source U-trained PacketUNet parent of realgain

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original F0 source roles, existing validation_full IDs, strict source-only frozen checkpoint proofs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No LoRa checkpoints used. WiSig source U-only parents and fixed source-selected R17 have compatible original contract; prior RX1 screen used for development.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final 2000 steps; low urban paired net >=2 in each deterministic half against direct, R17, WiSig realgain, first fusion and urban fusion; clean net >=-2 vs each; 2000 paired bootstrap 95% interval.

execution.gpu_policy: One worker on first GPU with >=8192 MiB free in order 7,2,3,6,1,4,0,5; LoRa GPU5 protected.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on illegal source/checkpoint, output collision, nonfinite update, absent finite nonzero first-step gradients for all three directions, incomplete predictions or scorer failure. Preserve other owners and outputs.

dimensions: 300 IDs excluding prior 2700 and one smoke

rows.method: Frozen R17 plus three real gain directions on prior spectrum, R07 backprojection, and WiSig realgain difference; source U Full low-urban waveform supervision.
rows.seed_notes: Existing epoch01 Full practical_low_urban source observations; source selector uses model seed + day; halves +3. No support.
rows.budget_ref: 2000 updates x 24 U_s, 48000 unlabeled exposures; inherited model training costs separate

notes: Source V historically exposed; excludes prior 2700 screening physical IDs and channel smoke ID 5fa0fd382eb8af0fbc4cc08b.
Source U epoch01 Full low urban paired cache, quantile>=0.15; no F/TX/V/target in training. Parent WiSig realgain source-only.
Three-direction gains share the LoRa core: .1 prior spectrum, .25 R07 adjoint residual and .25 independent realgain-minus-R17; dataset-specific width 32 and independent weights.
Source-only loss waveform MSE + .3 spectral + 1.5 clean R17 retention + .1 disturbed R17 retention.
Frozen default-head source score after both predictions fixed; full target test and DURA v1 control remain missing; historical target benchmark exposed.
